source_audit.condition: Comparison gate initializes enabled only when sources are available, the entity kind is item, and the item ID is unique.
source_audit.observed_behavior: No initial per-record disclosure is emitted for an ineligible chain.

source_audit.condition: A non-object provenance record or a record with a non-exact key set resets prior state and permanently disables comparisons for this item.
source_audit.observed_behavior: The schema finding is emitted, then processing continues; there is no unassessed disclosure for this or later records.

source_audit.condition: Invalid ticks, holder shapes, dangling holders, or ambiguous holder references invalidate the record; ambiguous holders are tracked separately.
source_audit.observed_behavior: Dangling references are explicitly named. Ambiguous references are explicitly named and lead to the one-shot notice below.

source_audit.condition: First ambiguous holder reference, from_holder or to_holder.
source_audit.observed_behavior: Emits one notice at that record, worded to cover this and all later records; boolean suppresses additional notices. This is not the requested per-record tail disclosure.

source_audit.condition: Missing/invalid source reference and any other invalid record.
source_audit.observed_behavior: Unknown or unavailable sources invalidate and latch the chain off. Ambiguous source IDs set the structural-finding prefix flag but do not themselves invalidate. Any invalid record permanently sets can_check_chain false.

source_audit.condition: Unique, valid record while comparison gate remains enabled.
source_audit.observed_behavior: Checks strict tick increase and holder continuity (including null from_holder on the first record), then advances prior holder/tick. Once latched off, later records do not re-enable comparisons.

findings.detail: No D1 table was available at either required check, so no table rows or recorded outputs could be replayed or diffed. C2 row-by-row verification remains unperformed.

r85-masked-ambiguous emits one unassessed notice at provenance[1] and no local disclosure at provenance[2], despite the comparison latch remaining off. Its matched unique-break control reports the record-2 chain break. Current code preserves conservative non-resumption and does not select a duplicate identity, but does not meet C1's per-record disclosure requirement.

The absent D1 table leaves the full stop/latch and emitted-signature inventory unaudited row by row. The source review identifies initial ineligibility, malformed record/key-set latches, invalid-record latches, ambiguous-source prefix behavior, and comparison findings for explicit table coverage.
